SITE INFORMATION

Privacy Policy

Last updated 2 October 2026. This policy applies to oneerp.org, me.oneerp.org, learn.oneerp.org, and meme.oneerp.org (together, the “sites”).

Information we collect

We receive information you choose to provide, such as your name, email address, messages, account details, and content you submit through site features. When you visit, our hosting and service providers may also receive technical information such as your IP address, browser or device type, pages requested, and access time.

How we use information

We use information to operate the sites, provide requested features, respond to enquiries, manage accounts and community submissions, maintain security, troubleshoot problems, and improve the experience. If you post in a public area, other visitors may be able to see your submission.

Cookies and browser storage

The sites and their service providers may use cookies or similar technologies for sign-in, preferences, site operation, and advertising. Some features store preferences, progress, or saved items in your browser. You can manage cookies and local data through your browser settings, although some features may then stop working as expected.

Advertising cookies

Third-party vendors, including Google, may use cookies to serve ads based on your visits to Meme Fast or other websites. Google's advertising cookies enable Google and its partners to serve ads based on visits to this site and other sites on the internet. You can opt out of personalized advertising in Google Ads Settings.

Service providers and external links

We use providers for hosting, authentication, data storage, content delivery, and other site functions. They may process information needed to provide those services. Third-party advertisements, market data, embedded content, and links may be governed by the provider’s own privacy policy. Information may be processed in countries other than your own.

Retention and security

We keep information for as long as reasonably needed for the purposes described here, subject to applicable requirements and service-provider settings. We use reasonable measures to protect information, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.

Your choices and contact

You can choose whether to use optional account or community features and can clear browser-stored data yourself. To ask about information you provided, including access, correction, or deletion, email microtoken1688@gmail.com. Please include the site and feature concerned so we can locate your request.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the sites change. The date above shows when it was last revised.
